body.description: Staplejaw: a desktop stapler creature, the hinged top is a big biting jaw with a row of staple teeth, black and chrome body, crouched low like a snapping turtle, stubborn glare. a small living machine creature (an Ohm), an old household or farm machine that woke up with a will of its own, weathered by years outdoors, no humans, no rider
body.style_description: modern indie action-adventure pixel art: chunky stylized proportions, big bold readable silhouette, saturated colours, lineless with strong graphic light and shadow shapes, expressive and punchy
